scenarios.status_quo: No changes, Fil+ continues with 10x multiplier
scenarios.looking_forward: Immediate: no new Fil+, new CC gets 10x, existing CC stays 1x (with rational re-sealing)
scenarios.looking_forward_no_churn: Same but existing CC miners cannot/do not re-seal

key_findings.conclusion: Looking Forward requires 10.0x higher pledge for new SPs, provides 1.39x reward improvement for existing CC miners (vs Daybreak 1.39x), and creates perverse churn incentive. Mathematically, universal 10x = universal 1x in steady state.
